consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if Rancher v1 provider configuration (providers.rancher) is present in the static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Rancher v1 provider configuration from static configuration and migrate to the Kubernetes CRD provider for Rancher 2.x deployments.

original.statement: The Rancher v1 provider has been removed in Traefik v3; configurations using it will prevent Traefik from starting.

decision.reason: [ev-96141bfb2be5] says the Rancher v1 provider was removed in v3, and that its configuration (providers.rancher in File YAML/TOML, or --providers.rancher on the CLI) "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". The upgraded Traefik failing to start is a failure that blocks the upgrade, so upgrade-blocked (mandatory work) fits. Critical severity fits a proxy that does not start at all. The remediation follows the guide: remove all Rancher provider configuration from the static configuration and use the Kubernetes CRD provider for Rancher 2.x.
